```{r}
link_densities <- c("01", "02", "03", "04", "05")
data_dir <- "../Data/HDIs with metadata"


process_ld <- function(ld) {
  file_path <- file.path(data_dir, paste0("HDIat", ld, "_w_meta_240910.csv"))
  
  df <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(time == 1, !is.na(n_spike_regs_sponpain)) %>%
    mutate(
      is_patient = recode(is_patient, '0' = 'HC', '1' = 'CBP'),
      thresh = sd(n_spike_regs_sponpain[is_patient == "HC"]) * 3,
      is_patient = case_when(
        is_patient == "CBP" & n_spike_regs_sponpain < thresh ~ "LoMo CBP",
        is_patient == "CBP" & n_spike_regs_sponpain >= thresh ~ "HiMo CBP",
        TRUE ~ is_patient
      ),
      is_patient = factor(is_patient, levels = c("HC", "LoMo CBP", "HiMo CBP")),
      link_density = paste0(as.integer(ld)*10, "%")
    ) %>%
    select(is_patient, n_spike_regs_sponpain, betweenness_bin, degree, clustercoef_bin,
           eigenvector_centrality_bin, age, promis_sleep_t1, link_density)
  
  return(df)
}

merged <- map_dfr(link_densities, process_ld)
df_ld01 <- merged[merged$link_density == "10%", ]
```

```{r}
# Original correlation plot from Figure 2b
plot_simple_scatter <- function(y_var, y_var_name, x_var, x_var_name, save = FALSE, 
                             save_dir = "../Graphs/correlation HDIs vs head motion",
                             width = 5, height = 2, dpi = 300) {
  
  p <- ggplot(data = df_ld01, aes_string(x = x_var, y = y_var, color = "is_patient")) +
    geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.1, height = 0.01), size = 1.2) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
    labs(title = paste0(y_var_name, " vs ", x_var_name),
         x = x_var_name,
         y = "HDI") + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c(HC = "#E06B58", `LoMo CBP` = "#44E7E0", `HiMo CBP` = "#596DF4")) + 
    scale_x_continuous(
      trans = sqrt_trans(), 
      breaks = c(0, 10, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1000), 
      labels = c("0", "10", "50", "100", "250", "500", "1000")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = 1),
      axis.ticks = element_line(size = 1),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
    )
  
  if (save) {
    if (!dir.exists(save_dir)) dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    filename <- file.path(save_dir, paste0("scatter_", tolower(gsub(" ", "_", y_var_name)), "_vs_", x_var_name, ".png"))
    ggsave(filename, p, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi)
  }
  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
# New density/scatter plot
# y_var = HDI
# x_var = head motion ("n_spike_regs_sponpain"), age, sleep
plot_jointplot <- function(y_var, y_var_name, x_var, x_var_name, save=FALSE, 
                             save_dir = "../Graphs/correlation HDIs vs head motion",
                             width = 5, height = 3, dpi = 600){
  p <- ggplot(df_ld01, aes_string(x = x_var, 
                          y = y_var,
                          color = "is_patient")) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(x = x_var_name, y = "HDI") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(HC = "#E06B58", 
                                  `LoMo CBP` = "#44E7E0", 
                                  `HiMo CBP` = "#596DF4")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),  # main panel
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),   # entire plot
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size=1),
      axis.ticks = element_line(size = 1),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10, face="bold"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
    )
  
  if (x_var == "n_spike_regs_sponpain"){
     p <- p +
    scale_x_continuous(
      trans = sqrt_trans(), 
      breaks = c(0, 10, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1000), 
      labels = c("0", "10", "50", "100", "250", "500", "1000"))
  }
  
  legend <- cowplot::get_legend(p)
  p_no_legend <- p + theme(legend.position = "none")
  p_with_marginals <- ggMarginal(p_no_legend, type = "density", groupColour = TRUE, groupFill = TRUE)
  p_final <- cowplot::plot_grid(legend, p_with_marginals, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.1, 1))

  if (save) {
    if (!dir.exists(save_dir)) dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE)
    filename <- file.path(save_dir, paste0("jointplot_", tolower(gsub(" ", "_", y_var_name)), "_vs_", x_var_name, ".png"))
    ggsave(filename, p_final, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi)
  }
  
  print(p_final)
  
}
```

```{r}
metrics <- c("betweenness_bin", "degree", "clustercoef_bin", "eigenvector_centrality_bin")

corr_tbl <- map_dfr(metrics, function(var) {
  
  df_ld01 %>%
    group_by(is_patient) %>%
    summarise(
      metric = var,
      r = cor(n_spike_regs_sponpain, .data[[var]], use = "complete.obs", method = "pearson"),
      p = cor.test(n_spike_regs_sponpain, .data[[var]])$p.value,
      ANOVA_HM_in_groups = aov(n_spike_regs_sponpain ~ is_patient, data = dat)$`Pr(>F)`,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
})

anova_tbl <- map_dfr(metrics, ~{
  f <- as.formula(paste0(.x, " ~ is_patient"))
  p <- summary(aov(f, data = df_ld01))[[1]][["Pr(>F)"]][1]

  tibble(metric = .x, anova_p = p)
})

anova_tbl

```

```{r}
# SUMMARY CORRELATION ACROSS LDs PLOTS
plot_correlation_across_lds <- function(correlate_with, correlate_with_name, metrics){

  corr_tbls <- map_dfr(metrics, function(var) {
    merged %>%
      group_by(link_density, is_patient) %>%
      summarise(
        correlation = round(cor(.data[[correlate_with]], .data[[var]], use = "complete.obs"), 3),
        p_value = cor.test(.data[[correlate_with]], .data[[var]])$p.value,
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(metric = var)
  })
  
  corr_tbls <- corr_tbls %>% arrange(is_patient, link_density)
  corr_tbls$metric <- factor(corr_tbls$metric, levels=metrics)
  
  
  
  p <- ggplot(corr_tbls, aes(x = link_density, y = correlation, color = is_patient, group = is_patient)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype="dotted", linewidth=0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ metric, ncol = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(HC = "#E06B58",
                                  `LoMo CBP` = "#44E7E0",
                                  `HiMo CBP` = "#596DF4")) +
    labs(x = "Link Density", y = paste0("Correlation: HDI vs ", correlate_with_name)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.8),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold")
    )
  
  return(p)
}
```


```{r}

path = "~/Documents/repos/brain_connectivity_in_chronic_pain/Graphs/correlation HDIs vs covariates/"
```
